environment.description: Same application container deployed on AWS ECS Fargate. Traffic ingress via NLB (Network Load Balancer) with TLS passthrough to an Envoy sidecar proxy (v1.28) running as a secondary container in the same task definition. Envoy listener configured with transport_socket using DownstreamTlsContext with require_client_certificate: true, and a validation_context referencing an internal SDS cluster that serves the CA bundle from AWS Private CA (subordinate CA arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:111122223333:certificate-authority/abc-def-123). The Envoy route configuration has a Lua filter that extracts the x-forwarded-client-cert header's SAN URI field and validates it matches the regex pattern 'spiffe://prod.internal/ns/frontend/sa/.*' before forwarding. Requests without a valid client certificate signed by the private CA, or with a SAN not matching the allowed service identity, receive TCP RST at the Envoy layer before reaching the application port. MongoDB connection uses SCRAM-SHA-256 auth with a user that has readWrite on productdb only.

config.nlb: TLS passthrough on port 443 to Envoy sidecar
config.lua_filter: validates XFCC SAN URI before route match
